walls.note: Front (figure's face and the THORBECKE die): Commons photographs; panoramas 01760 and 01761 show the rear and the OPTIMO CIVI side panel through the trees.

items.where: standing bronze statesman in a frock coat, left hand holding a rolled document at the chest, weight on one leg, 2.35 m
items.how: builder: tapered limbs and cylinders for legs, coat skirts and torso, shoulder ellipsoid, lapel strip, folded forearm, rolled document cylinder, head with hair; no facial modelling or coat folds

items.where: fluted column stump at his right with a cloth thrown over the top and a scroll under the right hand
items.how: builder: tapered drum with five flute bars, capital disc, cloth slab and scroll cylinder; the drape folds are not carved

items.where: THORBECKE in gilt capitals on the front die panel, OPTIMO CIVI / CIVES on the side panel, framed panels
items.how: builder: raised frames on three faces and 5x7 block lettering as gold run boxes (pixel-font.ts) for THORBECKE, OPTIMO CIVI and CIVES; the smaller dedication text on the third face is left blank

items.where: grey granite pedestal: two steps, base block, moulded neck and cornice, black bronze plate, 3.4 m to the plate
items.how: builder: stacked boxes at the photographed proportions

items.where: black iron railing with spear finials round the steps, taller corner posts with larger spears
items.how: builder: square railing of thin bars with cone spears and three rails, corner posts; the ring scrolls between the bars are omitted

walls.note: East face: the OPTIMO CIVI / CIVES panel (panorama 01761).
Back: the figure from behind with the stump (panorama 01760).

sources.name: Maarten Benschop, Standbeeld Thorbecke; Andries Jager, Het standbeeld van J.R. Thorbecke
